lane: co-training between a geophysical view (View A) and a surface view (View B), with disagreement as the discovery signal (Blum & Mitchell, COLT '98, pp. 92-100, doi:10.1145/279943.279962)
hypothesis: Thermal-gap hypothesis: a hot spring / high-geothermometry well that the VISIBLE fault catalogue cannot explain (distance to the nearest visible catalogue fault > 3 px = 300 m) is surface evidence of a fault that is absent from that catalogue. Co-training gates the emission: the candidate is accepted where View A (potential-field / subsurface) is confident about structure and View B (surface) abstains, which is the standing brief's A-only 'buried fault' population; the reverse disagreement (B confident, A abstains) is vetoed as a surface artefact.
why_new: The GDR 1391 INGENIOUS well/spring catalogue (sha-pinned in registry/data_manifest.json) has been used in this repository only as smooth DISTANCE channels (B_spring_dist, B_paleo_geotherm_dist, H58 cold-geothermometer field, H55/H57/H86 thermal priors). It has never been used as a per-site EXISTENCE test against the visible catalogue, which is the mechanism registered here. The measured motivation is in knowledge/97: only 23.3 % of hot sites (temp_c >= 30 C) lie within 300 m of labels.tif, against roughly 14 % expected for uniformly scattered points over the same footprint, and the file's own dist_known_fault_px column equals the distance to labels.tif exactly (Pearson 1.0000, re-measured this session).

inputs.footprint: 19-band finite intersection of data/training_features.tif, intersected with the finite domain of data/sample_submission.tif
inputs.off_catalogue_truth: data/external/derived_sgmc_faults_100m_u8.tif, restricted to pixels > 3 px from labels.tif
inputs.views_reused_not_forked: gems52.spatial.folds, gems52.evaluate_holdout (gems52-pooled-hide-v1), gems52.nodes.spacing_select, gems52.emit.greedy_emit (diagnostic), gems52.metric, gems52.gates, gems52.submission_writer

thermal_evidence_rule.gap_definition_fold: distance to the fold's VISIBLE catalogue > 3 px
thermal_evidence_rule.gap_definition_ship: distance to the FULL catalogue > 3 px

components.name: tc
components.source: training_features.tif band 6 (radiometric total count by bytes, IR-52-019)

field.veto: rank01(artefact) on positive support only (amendment form)

E1_hide_and_recover.instrument: gems52-pooled-hide-v1 (whole-component label-blind quadrants, buffer_px=80, visible catalogue masked pixel-exact)
E1_hide_and_recover.control_definition: random_gap samples allowed pixels with distance to the VISIBLE catalogue > 3 px, count-matched to the thermal_gap arm in the same fold

E2_off_catalogue.instrument: gems52-offcat-prevalence-h97: SGMC fault pixels > 3 px from labels.tif, thinned by whole 8-connected components (seed 9700) to <= 14088 px; ranking instrument only, never used to choose a budget
E2_off_catalogue.note: the reference taxonomy in knowledge/76 section 6 governs: ranking at a matched budget only

E3_mass_and_placement.note: credit density rho = TPw/S measured per arm on the FULL eligible set (no folds) against the catalogue is a descriptive diagnostic only; the shipping budget is chosen on E1 with the marginal rule of src/gems52/metric.py (raise mass while marginal expected credit > 0.2*DTI), not with the off-catalogue instrument

placement.method: gems52.nodes.spacing_select (priority order: thermal-gap dots first, co-training field second)
placement.catalogue_collar_reason: the champion family shows the <= 200 m ring earns exactly zero credit (knowledge/76 sections 1 and 7); the registered collar here is 3 px (300 m) because the hidden truth is not inside the kernel of any mapped fault under that same measurement

gates.independence_method: gems52.spatial.negative_block_errors + independence, 50 px blocks, 90th percentile view thresholds on labelled negatives
gates.format: gems52.gates.format_report (single band float32, EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, transform match, all-finite, values in [0,1])
gates.uniqueness: gems52.gates.uniqueness_report over submission/, docs/downloads/, data/scored/, data/reference/
gates.lane: rank-correlation (Spearman) with any registry raster <= 0.90 AND at most 70 % of dots within 3 px of any single registry raster; checked on the surface before placement and on the final dots
gates.not_the_union: Jaccard vs the union of the two views' spaced top-k supports at the same budget

budget.submission_slots: NOT spent; promotion is the separate selector step

verdict_rules.promote: E1 primary beats random_gap with a paired 95 % CI excluding 0 AND E1 primary >= 0.192829 AND all gates PASS
verdict_rules.negative: anything else; the run card and site must then say OK TO DOWNLOAD: YES / OK TO SUBMIT: NO (research-only)
